Name: A Less Yellow Stardew 1.1 patch
Author: DrummerD3
Description:
This is a patch for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/454/?]A Less Yellow Stardew[/url], originally by Lark the Brave, to be used with Stardew Valley version 1.1 beta.

99% of the credit goes to the original author, I just spent a couple hours combining his changes with ConcernedApe's changes to the base game, with a bit of tweaking for consistency.

This does REQUIRE [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/454/?]A Less Yellow Stardew[/url] to be installed. It can be installed over any of the dirt/grass combinations provided by ALYSD, however, if installed over any version besides "light dirt, grass 3" there will be noticeable seams, albeit only 1 or 2 instances of this in the entire valley.

I will not be making versions for the other dirt/grass combinations.

Final note to Lark the Brave: I only made this for myself and am uploading it to tide people over until your possible return. If you want me to remove this, simply send me a message, I am happy to oblige. Also, if you want to use my work as a jumping-off point for your own update, please feel free, no need to ask.



Also check out [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/269/?]my other mod[/url], a music mod that adds in select masterpieces from various other places, including Chrono Trigger, Cowboy Bebop, and even Morrowind!


Changelog:
v1.0 - release
v1.01 - fixed an issue where many black dots appeared in light sources.
v1.02 - fixed an issue related to the SV 1.1.1 update, which removed the stack-number indicator in the inventory.
